observations_not_findings: Unquoted label reference: French typography would normally set the label in guillemets. The capitalised form is unambiguous, no fr catalogue in this app uses guillemets, and round 2 accepted this same form. Disclosed, not filed, to avoid reopening a settled disposition for a preference.
'en direct' is the only occurrence of the word in the fr corpus; if the programme later standardises live on « en temps réel », this key follows that decision. Not a defect today.
Out-of-delta keys were not judged: round 2's per-key dispositions stand, and the hash reconstruction shows those bytes are unchanged.
